name: Example – Podcast Highlights
brief:
Clips must come from full episodes of the podcast published after the start date.
The host must be on screen or speaking for most of the clip.
Captions must mention the show's name and use the campaign hashtag.
No clips that misrepresent what a guest said or take quotes out of context.
No third-party logos or watermarks.
look_for: funny exchanges between host and guest
short, self-contained stories with a clear payoff
avoid: moments that depend on earlier parts of the episode
clips where neither host nor guest is the focus
manual_checks: Host or guest is the focus for the whole clip
Caption is accurate to what is said
